mapper.select: select id, prj_id prjId, name, start_date startDate, end_date endDate from milestone where prj_id = #{id}

select i.id id, i.milestone_id, GET_ISSID_TO_NAME(i.issue_id) name, i.issue_id issue_id, t.id timeline_id, t.contents contents, t.entry_date entry_date, t.type_cd type_cd from milestone_issue i left join milestone_timeline t on t.milestone_issue_id = i.id join milestone m on m.id=i.milestone_id where i.milestone_id=#{id}
SELECT id, milestone_id milestoneId, issue_id issueId FROM milestone_issue WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT ML_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
insert into milestone (id, prj_id, name, start_date, end_date) values (${id}, #{prjId}, #{name}, #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE})

SELECT ML_ISS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
insert into milestone_issue (id, milestone_id,issue_id) values (${id}, #{milestoneId}, #{issueId})

SELECT ML_TL_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
insert into milestone_timeline (id, milestone_issue_id, contents, entry_date, type_cd) values (${id}, #{milestoneIssueId}, #{contents}, #{entryDate}, #{typeCd})
